implementation: Parse [T] annotations, infer/check numeric ArrayExpr values, preserve a separate ValueType.array category, and reuse TensorLiteral plus checked rank-one storage/lowering. Enforce category agreement through value flow and reject array arithmetic/conversions/GPU placement. CPU worker array values have distinct keys and private layout identities 0x40000 + NumericType. No scheduler, ownership-runtime, checked ABI or numeric engine changes.

contract.types: Ordered immutable homogeneous arrays of int32/uint32/int64/uint64/float32/float64; aliases int/uint/float retain existing defaults.
contract.length: Runtime data, omitted from source [T] types; private shape facts may retain literal length and join branch lengths dynamically.
contract.inference: Each unannotated element independently follows scalar inference, in source order; no common-type promotion between elements.
contract.context: Expected [T] types supply numeric literal context; empty arrays require it; already typed values must conform exactly.
contract.evaluation: Each leaf once left-to-right; first runtime failure retains source location and publishes no partial array result.
contract.sharing: Arrays remain usable across ordinary/nested worker calls, cached awaits and recovery; retained outputs survive invocation/task settlement.
contract.categories: No implicit array/tensor interchange. Numeric/tensor arithmetic, reductions, matrix multiplication, conversions and transfers reject arrays.
contract.backend: Shared checked MLIR ranked storage with distinct source and worker layout categories; CPU-only in this slice.
contract.limits: Source/token/depth/value budgets and bounded collection elements, index extents and allocation bytes remain active.

qualification.scope: Focused arrays, prior tensor inference, frontend, control-flow, numeric/source/worker, storage and Metal regressions; not the full 361-test suite.
coverage: Six numeric types, aliases, default inference, explicit contexts, empty arrays, numeric identity/rank and source [T] display.
Conditional differing-length results; exact float64 signed zero, subnormal and max-finite data across eight ARM FP environments.
Named functions, inferred results, nested workers, immutable captures, cached awaits and TaskError recovery.
Distinct array/tensor keys and numeric layout identities when both categories are captured by one worker.
1/2/4-worker success, cancellation, deadlines, admission rejection and allocation injection positions 1-12; empty and original-source Arithmetic task failures.
Retained output cells checked after all task/runtime owners settle; no partial array payload on failure.
Source-ordered leaf failures and cleanup; diagnostic locations and preserved executables after invalid compilation.
Mixed identities in either order, task/Bool/nested array leaves, unsupported element types, writes and implicit tensor/array flows rejected.
Forged array storage and category changes rejected before native lowering; existing tensor and Boolean regressions.
Debug, optimized, ASan/UBSan and separate TSan runtime/generated variants plus sanitized frontend.

remaining_gates: Sequential array map and anonymous functions/lexical captures
Array result display in development CLI
Records, modules, native library packaging and editor tooling
Native distributed design discussion before implementation
